Third-party libraries (bundled so they work with no internet after the first load):
- pdf.js (pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, legacy build), Apache-2.0, by Mozilla. Reads text from PDF files on the phone.
- fflate 0.8.3, MIT, by Arjun Barrett. Opens .docx (zip) files on the phone.
They load only when a student adds a PDF or Word file.
